title: Resize to the minimum box
goal: Resize the accent bar to the minimum accepted width and height of 8.
prompt: Resize accent_01 to width 8 and height 8. That is the catalog minimum, so the edit is valid.

title: Clear the title text
goal: Set the title text to an empty string.
prompt: Set title_01 text to an empty string. An empty string is a valid text value.

title: Reject a stale revision
goal: Reject a set_text that claims expectedRevision 99 and leave the document unchanged.
prompt: Attempt to set title_01 to "Stale write" with expectedRevision 99. The session is at revision 0, so the edit must be rejected and the title must stay "Quarterly Review".

title: Reject deleting a slide that has children
goal: Reject deletion of slide_01 because it still has children, and keep the slide.
prompt: Try to delete slide_01. It still has child shapes, so the deletion must be rejected and slide_01 must remain.

title: Reject an unknown target
goal: Reject set_text on a target that does not exist and leave the document unchanged.
prompt: Try to set text on object id does_not_exist. The target is unknown, so nothing in the document may change.
baselineCode: const object = find("does_not_exist"); if (!object) throw new Error("unknown_target"); object.properties.text = "Nope";

title: Reject set_text on a slide
goal: Reject set_text on slide_01 because a slide is not a shape, and do not add a text property.
prompt: Try to set_text on slide_01. Slides are not text shapes, so the action must be rejected and slide_01 must not gain a text property.

title: Undo at revision 0
goal: Reject undo when the session is already at revision 0 and leave the document unchanged.
prompt: Call undo before any edit. There is nothing to undo, so the document must stay at its initial revision.

title: Roll back a partial transaction
goal: Attempt a transaction whose last action recolors the locked logo, and roll the whole batch back.
prompt: In one transaction, set the title to "Should Rollback", recolor accent_01 to #112233, and recolor locked logo_01 to #112233. The logo edit cannot apply, so the whole batch must roll back and the document must be unchanged.
baselineCode: find("title_01").properties.text = "Should Rollback"; find("accent_01").properties.fill = "#112233"; throw new Error("partial failure");

title: Sync when nothing drifted
goal: Call sync when the host has not diverged and leave the document unchanged.
prompt: Call sync. The host has not changed out of band, so the document and revision must stay as they are.
